title: Eurostar staff strike causes train cancellations between Paris and London

tea.why: Staff are protesting over salary negotiations and internal dissatisfaction regarding a luxury farewell event for a former executive.
tea.changed: Nov 25: Eurostar confirmed a surprise strike causing multiple cancellations and delays on routes between Paris, London, and Brussels.

summary: On November 25, 2026, Eurostar staff initiated a surprise strike, leading to significant disruptions and the cancellation of multiple train services between Paris and London. According to reports, the industrial action is linked to ongoing mandatory annual salary negotiations. Additionally, sources indicated that internal frustration regarding a high-profile farewell party for a former executive contributed to the unrest. Eurostar management confirmed the strike was reported to them overnight and advised passengers to check their travel status and avoid stations if their trains were cancelled. The company stated that it remains open to constructive dialogue with unions. While the primary impact is on the Paris-London route, some delays were also reported in Brussels. Passengers affected by the cancellations have been offered the option to rebook or receive a full refund.
response: Eurostar management stated they were informed of the strike overnight, expressed apologies to passengers, and called on unions to continue direct, constructive dialogue. The company is offering refunds or rebooking options.

updates.text: Eurostar announces a surprise strike causing cancellations and delays on Paris-London and Brussels routes.
Reports emerge that the strike is linked to salary negotiations and internal discontent over a luxury event for a former executive.
